Rule Description: This kernel grid is too small to fill the available resources on this device, resulting in only 0.6 full waves across all SMs. Look at Launch Statistics for more details.

If you execute __syncthreads() to synchronize the threads of a block, it is recommended to have at least two blocks per multiprocessor (compared to the currently executed 1.2 blocks) This way, blocks that aren't waiting for __syncthreads() can keep the hardware busy.
